text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a prod rollout tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 PDT for runtime engine v6.1 plus new quant profile q2. This is a combined kernel + quant change, low-risk but we need an explicit deploy owner and smoke leads. Anyone available to own the deploy and rollback?
priya: I can own deploy steps and coordinate canary. Will need @sre-oncall for capacity checks.
jordan: I can handle perf smoke runs and check KV cache behavior during canary.
marta: I will run promptset/sanity and monitor quality regressions. Adding QA to watch crit prompts.
alex: Awesome. @release-manager can you reserve the 10:00 slot and create the canary route? Also add a short runbook link.
release-manager: Slot reserved. Creating canary at 10:00 -> 5% traffic / 30m evaluation. Runbook: /runbooks/engine-rollouts (brief notes).
sre-oncall: I'll validate GPU pool headroom and pre-warm the nodes at 09:30. If autoscaler trips, I'll pause. Also set alert thresholds for p95/p99.
qa-bot: Automated baseline tests queued: promptset/sanity (fast), eval/quality-regressions (smoke). Expect results ~15m after deployment.
alex: Smoke checklist (shared):
```
- create canary: traffic=5% duration=30m
- run perf job: perf/engine-smoke (20m)
- run QA quickset: promptset/sanity
- monitor: p99 latency, tokens/sec, error-rate, cpu/gpu util
- rollback plan: pin model to engine v6.0 + quant q1 and rollback route to stable
- post-canary: 1h staged ramp to 25% then 100% if green
```
priya: I'll push the deploy PR and tag @jordan @marta for pre-merge review. PR will include a feature flag gate: `enable_q2_quant` so we can safely toggle.
jordan: Confirmed. I'll have perf scripts ready in perf/engine-smoke and a Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/apps/runtime-engine-ops
marta: QA note — watch for repeated hallucination pattern seen in last quant test (promptset id: 2026-q1-23). If we see >0.5% regression on that prompt, stop the rollout.
alex: Good guardrail. Also watch tokenization mismatch logs — sometimes quant changes surface token split diffs.
release-manager: Minor note: CI artifact names will be engine-v6.1-quant-q2-<sha>. Will keep stable ready: engine-v6.0-quant-q1-rollback.
sre-oncall: I'll add temporary trace sampling to 100% for the canary to get traces. If any error spikes or GPU OOMs, I'll trigger rollback.
priya: Deploy steps summary I will run at T-15m in #eng-runtime and post status updates in this thread. After canary passes, I'll escalate to staged ramp.
alex: Thanks team. If no objections, proceed — confirm with a thumbs up. :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
marta: :thumbsup:
qa-bot: promptset/sanity passed on staging at 08:40.
release-manager: PR merged, artifact built: engine-v6.1-quant-q2-0a1b2c. Canary scheduled.
priya: Starting deploy in 10.  Will post each step.
alex: tagging this thread for post-rollout notes. If rollback occurs, please include reason and timestamps.
